frost.name: Biting Frost
frost.flavour: Best part about frost - bodies of the fallen don't rot so quickly.

fog.name: Impenetrable Fog
fog.flavour: A good commander's dream... a bad one's horror.

rain.name: Torrential Rain
rain.flavour: Even the rain in this land smells like piss.

clear.name: Clear Weather
clear.flavour: The sun's shinin', Dromle! Maybe there's hope left after all...

horn.name: Commander's Horn
horn.flavour: Plus one to morale, minus three to hearing.

scorch.name: Scorch
scorch.flavour: Pillars of flame turn the mightiest to ash. All others tremble in shock and awe.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.flavour: When you run out of peasants, decoys also make decent arrow fodder.

geralt.name: Geralt of Rivia
geralt.flavour: If that's what it takes to save the world, 'twere better that world perished.

ciri.name: Cirilla Fiona
ciri.flavour: Know when fairy tales cease to be tales? When people start believing in them.

vesemir.name: Vesemir
vesemir.flavour: If you're to be hanged, ask for water. Anything can happen before they fetch it.

zoltan.name: Zoltan Chivay
zoltan.flavour: Life without old mates and booze is like a woman without a rump.

yennefer.name: Yennefer of Vengerberg
yennefer.flavour: Magic is Chaos, Art and Science. It is a curse, a blessing and a progression.

blue.name: Blue Stripes Commando
blue.flavour: I'd do anything for Temeria. Mostly, though, I kill for her.

infantry.name: Poor Infantry
infantry.flavour: I's a war veteran, I is. Spare a crown?

reaver.name: Crinfrid Reavers
reaver.flavour: Haven't had much luck with monsters of late, so we enlisted.

ballista.name: Ballista
ballista.flavour: 'Usually we give 'em female names.' 'Like Jenny?' 'More like Bertha.'

trebuchet.name: Trebuchet
trebuchet.flavour: Castle won't batter itself down, now will it? Get them trebuchets rollin'!

catapult.name: Catapult
catapult.flavour: The gods help those who have better catapults.

siegfried.name: Siegfried of Denesle
siegfried.flavour: We're on the same side, witcher. You'll realize this one day.

medic_nr.name: Field Medic
medic_nr.flavour: Stitch red to red, white to white, and everything will be all right.

dijkstra.name: Sigismund Dijkstra
dijkstra.flavour: Gwent's like politics, just more honest.

stennis.name: Prince Stennis
stennis.flavour: He ploughin' wears golden armor. Golden. 'Course he's an arsehole.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.flavour: If ghouls are part of the Circle of Life... then it's a damn vicious circle.

nekker.name: Nekker
nekker.flavour: Damn things are almost cute, if you ignore the whole vicious killer aspect.

foglet.name: Foglet
foglet.flavour: Fog creeps on little cat feet. Foglets creep over the bodies of their victims.

harpy.name: Harpy
harpy.flavour: There are many species of harpy, and all are kleptomaniacs.

griffin.name: Griffin
griffin.flavour: Griffins like to toy with their prey. Eat 'em alive, piece by piece.

katakan.name: Katakan
katakan.flavour: Drinking the blood of the Continent since the Conjunction.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.flavour: Wolves aren't as bad as they say. Werewolves, though - they're worse.

forktail.name: Forktail
forktail.flavour: Fork tails... Bah! Fuckers' tails're more like cleavers.

arachas.name: Arachas
arachas.flavour: Ugly - nature's way of saying 'Stay away.'

fiend.name: Fiend
fiend.flavour: A fiend looks a bit like a deer. An enormous, evil deer.

draug.name: Draug
draug.flavour: Some men cannot admit defeat. Some keep fighting from beyond the grave.

imlerith.name: Nithral
imlerith.flavour: Ladd nahw! Kill them! Litter the earth with their entrails!

nauzicaa.name: Nauzicaa Brigade
nauzicaa.flavour: The Emperor will teach the North discipline.

impera.name: Impera Brigade Guard
impera.flavour: The Impera Brigade never surrenders. Ever.

blackarch.name: Black Infantry Archer
blackarch.flavour: I aim for the knee. Always.

siegesup.name: Siege Engineer
siegesup.flavour: Wielded correctly, a protractor can be a deadly weapon.

arbalest.name: Arbalest
arbalest.flavour: A crossbow cares not for courage - only for range.

menno.name: Menno Coehoorn
menno.flavour: I'll take an attentive reconnaissance unit over a fine cavalry brigade any day.

vattier.name: Vattier de Rideaux
vattier.flavour: There's never been a problem a well-planned assassination couldn't solve.

stefan.name: Stefan Skellen
stefan.flavour: My mark scars the face of our future empress. That is my proudest achievement.

cahir.name: Cahir Mawr Dyffryn
cahir.flavour: His eyes flashed under his winged helmet. Fire gleamed from his sword's blade.

morvran.name: Morvran Voorhis
morvran.flavour: Summer sun on the quiet waters of the Alba - that's Nilfgaard to me.

dwarf.name: Dwarven Skirmisher
dwarf.flavour: Worked a pickaxe all me life. Battleaxe won't be any trouble.

mahakam.name: Mahakam Defender
mahakam.flavour: I'm telling ye, we're born fer battle - we slash straight at their knees!

dolarcher.name: Dol Blathanna Archer
dolarcher.flavour: Take another step, dh'oine. You'd look better with an arrow between your eyes.

vrihedd.name: Vrihedd Brigade Officer
vrihedd.flavour: Hatred burns brighter than any fire, and cuts deeper than any blade.

havekar.name: Havekar Smuggler
havekar.flavour: I fight for whoever's paying the best. Or whoever's easiest to rob.

ithlinne.name: Ithlinne
ithlinne.flavour: Famed for constantly prophesying the world's doom. Not much fun at parties.

yaevinn.name: Yaevinn
yaevinn.flavour: We are the drops of rain that together make a ferocious storm.

ciaran.name: Ciaran aep Easnillen
ciaran.flavour: The path to freedom is paved in blood, not ink.

filavandrel.name: Filavandrel aén Fidháil
filavandrel.flavour: Though we are now few and scattered, our hearts burn brighter than ever.

isengrim.name: Isengrim Faoiltiarna
isengrim.flavour: It dawns on them once they notice my scar: a realization of imminent death.

tordarroch.name: Clan Tordarroch Armorsmith
tordarroch.flavour: Steel from Mahakam, temper from Skellige. Nothing bites through it.

berserker.name: Young Berserker
berserker.flavour: The bear-shirt takes him, and the man is gone till the killing's done.

shieldmaid.name: Shieldmaiden
shieldmaid.flavour: Raise your shields, sisters! We die standing or not at all.

donar.name: Donar an Hindar
donar.flavour: An Hindar keeps his word - and his axe - well sharpened.

dimun.name: Clan Dimun Pirate
dimun.flavour: We came for the plunder. We stayed for the fight.

longship.name: War Longship
longship.flavour: Fifty oars, one drum, and a hold full of hungry madmen.

birna.name: Birna Bran
birna.flavour: A mother's ambition is the sharpest blade in Kaer Trolde.

holger.name: Holger Blackhand
holger.flavour: One hand black as pitch, the other red with oath-breakers' blood.

madman.name: Madman Lugos
madman.flavour: They call me mad. I call it not caring who I kill.

hjalmar.name: Hjalmar an Craite
hjalmar.flavour: A true jarl leads from the front - sword first, sense later.

nr.name: Foltest
nr.title: The Steel-Forged
nr.desc: Once per game: clear all weather effects.
nr.flavour: It is natural and beautiful that a man should love his sister.

nilfgaard.name: Emhyr var Emreis
nilfgaard.title: The White Flame
nilfgaard.desc: Once per game: draw a card from your deck.
nilfgaard.flavour: Your motives do not interest me. Only results.

monsters.name: Eredin
monsters.title: Destroyer of Worlds
monsters.desc: Once per game: return your strongest fallen unit to your hand.

scoiatael.name: Francesca Findabair
scoiatael.title: Queen of Dol Blathanna
scoiatael.desc: Once per game: sound a Commander's Horn on a row you choose.
scoiatael.flavour: To live in peace, we first must kill. This is human oppression's cruel finale.

skellige.name: Crach an Craite
skellige.title: An Craite Jarl
skellige.desc: Once per game: summon your strongest fallen unit to the battlefield.
skellige.flavour: A king's gotta be wise. A king's gotta command respect. A king's gotta have stones.
